findings.text: follow-on: `_real_store_traces` is added here and again, near-verbatim, at tests/test_run_store.py:205 (everything but the docstring's first line is identical), so the store-search adapter has two owners and a change to one leaves the other stale.

follow-on: the migration narrows the guard from the whole real home's top-level name+mtime listing to crew/live and crew/watch filtered by the module's run ids, so a leak into another crew sub-tree (crew/runs, crew/reports) or into docs/state is no longer observed by these six guards.
